# github_enterprise_scim_group (Data Source)

Reads existing Enterprise Managed Users SCIM identities. Read-only: it never provisions users or groups and never manages membership; the IdP remains the only SCIM writer. Look the group up by scim_group_id, display_name or external_id; a name lookup fails unless it matches exactly one group.

## Example

```hcl
data "github_enterprise_scim_group" "example" {
  provider = github-enterprise

  scim_group_id = "example-group-id"
}

# Look the group up by its IdP name instead of copying the raw SCIM ID. The
# lookup fails when more than one group matches, so it never picks one silently.
data "github_enterprise_scim_group" "by_name" {
  provider = github-enterprise

  display_name = "Platform"
}
```

## Schema

| Attribute | Type | Requirement | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display_name` | `String` | Optional | SCIM displayName to look the group up by. Fails when more than one group matches, so an ambiguous IdP name never picks a group silently. |
| `enterprise_slug` | `String` | Optional | Enterprise account slug. Defaults to the provider-level enterprise_slug. |
| `external_id` | `String` | Optional | IdP externalId to look the group up by. Fails when more than one group matches. |
| `id` | `String` | Read-only | enterprise_slug:raw SCIM group ID. |
| `scim_group_id` | `String` | Optional | Opaque, case-sensitive SCIM group ID from GitHub. Use this raw value, not the data source's Terraform id, as a team's group_id. Set exactly one of scim_group_id, display_name or external_id. |

See the [provider guide](https://github.com/vmvarela/terraform-provider-github-enterprise#authentication) for authentication, ownership and compatibility requirements.
